The 6Sh118 backpack is part of the 2nd generation "Ratnik" gear kit for combat. The 6Sh118 is a modernization of the 6B38 Permyachka model backpack. The 6Sh118 "BOSS" backpack is designed to carry fire support equipment, weapons, ammunition, elements of mountain equipment, as well as the personal belongings of individual soldiers. The backpack can be used during combat operations, long hikes, and raid events. Makes a perfect bacpack for loot runs. If you have the strength.
